evidence_labels.FAILED_HOLDOUT: stable discovery pattern did not satisfy the frozen holdout rule
evidence_labels.INSUFFICIENT: combination samples below 8 are descriptive only
evidence_labels.NO_STABLE_DISCOVERY_THRESHOLD: no threshold family passed the predeclared discovery stability rule
evidence_labels.OOS_SUPPORTED: discovery threshold retains direction and minimum effect/sample in untouched 2022+ holdout; not causal proof

governance.combination_policy: cross-market/cross-actor combinations require both component actor changes >= P75 magnitude; results remain research-only

horizons.friday: exact weekday cumulative from release anchor

horizons.tuesday: exact weekday cumulative from release anchor

governance.threshold_selection: lowest pre-2022 threshold with a three-cutoff same-sign 1W neighborhood; never best-return optimization

information_contract.exact_weekday_rule: exact next-week Monday-Friday; a missing exact weekday breaks the cumulative weekday path and is never relabeled
information_contract.public_availability: canonical CFTC release calendar at 15:30 America/New_York
information_contract.release_anchor: first market close on/after Friday release target
